Warum ist Streusalz so schädlich für Ihr: Why is road salt so harmful to your car?
Streusalz löst sich im Schneematsch zu e: In slush, road salt dissolves into a salty brine. This brine creeps into seams, gaps and cavities and stays damp there for a long time. Together with oxygen, it promotes corrosion. Areas where the paint is already damaged are particularly at risk, such as small stone chips on the bonnet and sills.
Auch auf intaktem Lack hinterlässt Salz: Salt leaves its mark on intact paint too. Dried salt crusts act like fine sandpaper as soon as you wipe over them with a cloth or brush. On wheels, salt combines with brake dust to form a stubborn layer that gets harder to remove with every week.

Der beste Zeitpunkt ist ein trockener Ta: The best time is a dry day with temperatures above freezing, ideally shortly after you have driven a lot on gritted roads. The salt has then not been on the car for long, and the water can dry off well after the wash.
Bei Frost sollten Sie auf eine Wäsche ve: In frosty weather you should skip washing. Water in door seals, locks and on the wiper blades can freeze. In the worst case, doors will no longer open or seals tear.

Jeder Schritt ins Auto bringt im Winter: In winter, every time you get into the car you bring water with you: snow on your shoes, wet jackets, a damp umbrella. The meltwater ends up in the floor mats and in the carpet underneath. Then there is your breath, which releases moisture on every journey.
Solange das Auto in der Kälte steht, kan: As long as the car is parked in the cold, this moisture can hardly escape. The next time you start the car, it condenses on the cold windows, and the windows mist up.
Gelegentlich steckt auch ein technischer: Occasionally there is also a technical reason behind it, such as a leaking door seal, a blocked drain or a damp cabin filter. If the carpet keeps getting wet even though you dry the mats, you should have this checked at a garage.

Auf der Innenseite der Scheiben bildet s: Over time, a fine film of dust, grease and vapours from the plastics forms on the inside of the windows. Water vapour condenses particularly easily on this film. Clean inside windows therefore mist up much less and clear more quickly. Clean them with a glass cleaner and two clean microfibre cloths: one for cleaning, one for buffing.
Gummimatten mit hohem Rand sind im Winte: Rubber mats with a high edge are the best choice in winter, because they catch the meltwater before it soaks into the carpet. Empty them regularly.
Textilmatten sollten Sie bei Nässe herau: Take textile mats out when they are wet and let them dry completely in a warm room. The white salt marks can then usually be vacuumed off. Stubborn marks can be removed with lukewarm water and a textile cleaner. Afterwards, the same applies again: let them dry well.

Warum beschlagen meine Autoscheiben im W: Why do my car windows mist up so badly in winter?
Warme, feuchte Luft im Innenraum trifft: Warm, humid air in the interior meets the cold windows, and the water vapour condenses there. The more moisture there is in the car, for example from wet mats or clothing, and the dirtier the inside of the windows, the more they mist up.
Hilft die Klimaanlage auch im Winter?: Does the air conditioning help in winter too?
Ja. Die Klimaanlage entzieht der Luft Fe: Yes. The air conditioning removes moisture from the air. Direct the fan at the windscreen, switch on the air conditioning and avoid recirculation mode. That is the fastest way to clear the windows.
Wie bekomme ich Salzränder aus den Fußma: How do I get salt marks out of the floor mats?
Lassen Sie die Matten zuerst vollständig: First let the mats dry completely and vacuum off the salt crystals. Light marks can be removed with lukewarm water and a textile cleaner. It is important to let the mats dry well afterwards. For deep-set marks, professional wet cleaning helps.
Was tun, wenn es im Auto muffig riecht?: What should I do if my car smells musty?
Ein muffiger Geruch ist oft ein Zeichen,: A musty smell is often a sign that moisture has settled in the carpet or upholstery. Drying alone is then usually not enough. A thorough interior cleaning with wet cleaning, drying and odour neutralisation eliminates the cause instead of masking it.
